Ready for the maintainer to merge at the next minor cut. No blocking findings.

SAFETY review. All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3280`.
The trial merge uses upstream main `1d5de9aeb846b83ee69a6cbbfd6f2ee8cdd3230e`.
The law check uses that main's `AGENTS.md`.

## What looks good

- The option stays off by default. Existing Fanuc goldens still match exactly.
- The tests check operation boundaries, the R level, canned cycles, probe sections, and invalid levels.
- The decision record states the chosen behavior and the remaining scope of #2603.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: 118 steps; 823 tests passed; one test ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | PASS: 27 steps; one ignored test ran and passed |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | PASS: 3 steps; two tests passed |

The heavy gate built the app tests in release mode.
It ran `every_slow_kind_on_a_mill_turn_keeps_the_work_spindle_within_the_chuck` successfully.
The other 25 selected heavy suites contained no ignored tests.

Light tests run:

- `the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations_light`: PASS, one test.
- `wide_rectangular_pocket_is_cleared_by_parallel_lanes_light`: PASS, one test.

No fixture or importer change triggers an extra suite under the requested selection rules.

## Mutations

I repeated two mutations with the PR's test assertions in a temporary harness under `/tmp`.
The harness changes script text in memory. It leaves the checkout unchanged.

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Remove `aiccOff()` before the canned cycle | RED: `fanuc_aicc_on_brackets_each_operation`; assertion: `G05.1 Q0 before the canned cycle` |
| Remove the spindle and probe guard in `aiccOn()` | RED: `fanuc_aicc_skips_a_probe_section`; assertion: `no AICC around G31` |
| Use the unchanged script again | GREEN: all seven AICC tests passed |

All seven tests also passed before the mutations.

## Goldens

No golden file changed. `fanuc_post` and `script_fanuc` passed against the existing goldens.
There are no moved golden lines to check.

None.

## Notes

The PR correctly uses `Refs #2603` for partial work. The remaining machine questions stay open.
The real 31i-A5 was not exercised, as the PR body states.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f5d560c7d307dba42234d3b2285863cc15331dc1 -->
Second safety read (Opus, read-only): clean

Scope: I read the diff of `assets/posts/fanuc.cps`, the full post at the head, `crates/post/tests/fanuc_aicc.rs` and `docs/decisions/2603-fanuc-aicc.md`. I did not build or run the tests.

**State**
- The PR is open and not merged. The base is `main`. GitHub reports it as `MERGEABLE`.
- `origin/main..head` has one commit (`f5d560c7d`). The PR carries no commit of a different PR.

**G05.1 words that the post writes**
The post writes only these two blocks. The tests assert them:
```
G05.1 Q1 R5
G05.1 Q0
```
(`R` is `aiContourLevel`. The default is 5. `fanuc_aicc_level_is_the_option` pins `G05.1 Q1 R1`.)

**Checks**
1. Q1 only when the option is on. `aiccOn()` returns immediately when `aiContourControl` is false. It also does not arm when the spindle is stopped or in a probe section. `smoothActive` is set only by `aiccOn()`. On `main`, no code sets `smoothActive` to true. Thus `aiccOff()` writes nothing when the option is off.
2. Q0 before each mode change that is necessary:
   - Tool change: `T.. M6` is written only in `startPreamble()`, and only after `endPreamble()` closed the previous section. `endPreamble()` calls `smoothOff()` -> `aiccOff()`. The mode never stays on across a tool change.
   - Program end: `onClose()` calls `endPreamble()` before `retractHome(true)` (G28 or G53) and before `M30`.
   - G28 / G53 / M0 / M1 of `afterOp()`: they come after `smoothOff()` in `endPreamble()`.
   - Canned cycle: `aiccOff()` is before the cycle block in `onCycle()`. AICC is not armed again in that section. This is the conservative direction.
   - G68 / G69: Q1 comes after G68, and Q0 comes before G69. Q0 comes after G80 and before M9 and M5.
3. Option off: the output does not change. `smoothOn()` keeps its old path. `smoothOff()` moved after `G80`, but it writes nothing when the option is off. The PR changes no golden file (no file under `tests/golden`). `fanuc_aicc_is_off_by_default` pins "no G05.1".
4. Range: the option is declared `integer`, `min: 1`, `max: 10`, `default: 5`, with the boolean default `false`. The host refuses R11 (`fanuc_aicc_options_are_declared_off_and_bounded`). The post also refuses a value out of range one time, by name: `AI contour control level 11 - G05.1 Q1 takes R1 to R10; not written`. Then it writes no G05.1. This is a visible refusal on the safe side.
5. Clean-room: the provenance is the machine owner's own words on #2603 and the Doosan DNM manual that `doosan-dnm.cps` already cites. The comments and the message text are original. I found no text that is copied from a different post.

**Notes (not blockers, P7 follow-up if wanted)**
- `probeSeat()` does not call `aiccOff()`. A `G31` move in a section with a turning spindle and a tool that is not a touch probe would be written under AICC. A real touch-probe section never arms AICC (`fanuc_aicc_skips_a_probe_section`). The result would be an alarm on the control, not a gouge.
- `G43.4` (stage D, TCPM) can be written in the middle of a section while AICC is on. I did not find a public source that confirms this order for the 31i. The option is off by default.
- The comment in `fanuc_aicc_on_brackets_each_operation` says "Two milling ops", but the count is 3, because the drill op arms and then turns off before `G81`. This is correct, but the comment is not exact.

Coordinator: this PR merges by the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-21 ("merge using the recommended option"; a reviewed `feat` merges now). The reviews that this merge relies on, both on head f5d560c7d: mkinney's collaborator marker (clean) and the second Opus safety read (comment 7077126460, clean). `G05.1 Q1` is written only with the option on; `G05.1 Q0` comes before each tool change, each canned cycle, G28/G53 and M30; no golden changes with the option off; the level is range-checked. The three notes of the read are filed as P7. I merge it on head f5d560c7d. It is a fork PR, so its branch stays.
